special_message.title: A Little Reminder
special_message.text: Whatever this week brings, remember how proud I am of you. You are doing amazing!

quotes.quote: Whenever you feel overwhelmed today, take a slow breath and remember how remarkably capable you are. I see how hard you work, and I believe in you with all my heart.
quotes.author: Always in Your Corner

quotes.quote: You have this quiet strength and brilliant mind that always finds a way forward. Walk into today knowing someone is endlessly proud of you and cheering you on.
quotes.author: Cheering for You

quotes.quote: Don't worry about having every detail figured out at once. Just take it one step at a time today — you are doing so much better than you realize, and I love you endlessly.
quotes.author: Gentle Reminder

quotes.quote: Your passion and dedication inspire me every single day. Go show today what you are made of, my favorite person in the world.
quotes.author: With All My Love

quotes.quote: Breathe easy today. Remember that no class, no project, and no review defines your worth. You are extraordinary, and I will always be right here backing you up.
quotes.author: Here for You

quotes.quote: I know today has a lot in store, but there is nothing you cannot handle. You have the talent, the heart, and all my love behind you.
quotes.author: Forever Believing in You

quotes.quote: May today be kind to you, may your focus be clear, and may you feel how deeply loved and appreciated you are every single hour.
quotes.author: Thinking of You Always
